name: to_datetime_eq_bare_field
note: Bare-field temporal equality: Eq(person.properties.signup_date, toDateTime("2024-09-09 08:30:00")). Only the right side goes through toDateTime, so the VM compares a plain string against a HogDateTime — the equality counterpart of behavioral_to_datetime_ordering. The Rust VM's eq_op used to handle only the both-temporal case and answered false here while the Python/TS VMs answered true; all six comparison opcodes now share one coercion. See the module-level provenance caveat.
